role: Two finite legacy menu public fake-event helper boundaries
reviewer: Codex implementation-phase individual review; complete independent audit pending

reviews.decision: The public CDK21.2.14 screen-reader mouse/touch helper declarations are stable and match the authenticated untouched16 reference. Their complete runtime expression trees are identical. Actual original and both minimum public exports pass169 predicate/getter cases each. The two exact tagged legacy menu handler bodies pass44 replayed origin/submenu cases per subject with genuine public helpers; fake events preserve input origin and do not prevent focus, genuine mouse input respects button/submenu conditions and genuine touch sets touch origin. Twelve mutants fail and a local import alias passes. This closes only the finite imported helper boundary; complete Angular menu/native focus/accessibility and runtime-floor evidence remain separate.
